{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of December 2009 – March 2010. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|Virtual Block 6.2: Domain Of Evil]]. The Players Committee released 6.2 on 7 December 2009 and said: "Cards will be Tournament legal December 21st."<ref name="news83">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=83 Virtual Set 6.2 is released], Players Committee (7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222734/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=83 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pdf62">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Domain Of Evil''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The pool lasted until [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|Virtual Block 6.3]] became legal. The Players Committee planned that for 14 days after a 15 March 2010 release, which is 29 March 2010; no confirmation of that date was found.<ref name="hp201003">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (news item "Virtual Set: 6.3 Mercenaries – Details", 18 February 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100307212505/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 7 March 2010]</ref> At the time the Players Committee called its constructed format its "standard playing format"<ref name="hp2009">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (news item "Virtual Set 6: Reflections 4 and Errata Released (Updated)", 16 September 2009, and "standard playing format" text). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 18 September 2009]</ref>, and event listings said "Open Constructed".<ref name="cal2009dec">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (event calendar). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091223054500/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 23 December 2009]</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–5 and Virtual Block 6.1–6.2
* '''In use:''' 21 December 2009 – about 28 March 2010 (until 6.3 became legal; see below)
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|6.2 Domain Of Evil]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]] (110 cards).<ref name="w-r4">[[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 4, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Seventeen of the Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]; see [[Virtual Shields]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|6.2 Domain Of Evil]] (26 cards).<ref name="w-doe">[[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf62" />

== History ==
Domain Of Evil was first announced as a different set, Galaxy At War, for 7 December 2009 with tournament legality on 21 December.<ref name="news79">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=79 ANNOUNCEMENT: Galaxy At War – Block 1 Release], Players Committee (28 October 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222729/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=79 Internet Archive]</ref> On 5 November 2009 the Players Committee instead made the 7 December release a set of about 25 cards continuing the V6: Reflections IV block, meant to adjust "the meta balance between the sides of the force" and to address holdovers from the Revolution mass errata.<ref name="news81">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=81 Virtual Set Release Date revision(s)], Players Committee (5 November 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091126195611/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=81 Internet Archive]</ref>

Compared with [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.1]], the pool adds the 26 cards of Domain Of Evil (19 Dark Side, 7 Light Side).<ref name="w-doe" /> The repackaged PDFs of Virtual Blocks 1–5 carry the same 7 December 2009 date.<ref name="vb1" />
